+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M39ZMNME683Y75PX48NQKTEN
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: Add the per-model generation queue at the executor seam and move Recording to its own lock
+---
+## Why
+
+One GPU runs one generation at a time. Now a turn holds `ResidentModelGates.generation` (`Concurrency/ResidentModelGates.swift`) for the whole turn, tool bodies included. The design (see ^8nqkten) makes one pass of the tool loop one queue item. This task adds the queue and the executor wrapper. It does NOT yet remove the turn-long gate (see the next task).
+
+## What to do
+
+1. Add a `GenerationQueue` type over `AsyncSemaphore(value: 1)`. The `PoolEntry` owns it (`Resolution/ModelPool.swift:72`, `:248`). It replaces `ResidentModelGates.generation`, or `ResidentModelGates` holds it.
+2. Add a queued `LanguageModel` wrapper, shaped like `RecordingLanguageModel.Executor` (`Recording/RecordingLanguageModel.swift:69-113`). Its executor `respond`: `try await queue.waitUnlessCancelled()` (`Concurrency/AsyncSemaphore.swift:151`), then the inner executor for one pass, then `queue.signal()` in a `defer`. Its `Executor.Configuration` compares by the identity of the inner model configuration AND of the queue.
+3. Give the queue to the live container. Challenges to the design text:
+   - The design says "wire it at `LiveModelLoader.swift:53` and `:130`". But `ModelPool` makes the gates AFTER `load()` returns the container (`ModelPool.swift:247-248`). The container thus does not know the queue. Choose one: (a) the container makes and owns the queue and the pool entry reads it, or (b) `makeSession` receives the queue. Prefer (a): one resident container is one pool entry, so the identity is the same, and the eight `makeSession` overloads do not change.
+   - `LoadedLLMContainer` is a `public` protocol (`Resolution/ModelLoader.swift:31`). Do not break it. Add a requirement with a default implementation only if it is necessary.
+   - Keep a reference to the raw `MLXLanguageModel`. `modelTurnsThinkingOffByTemplateFlag()` does `model as? MLXLanguageModel` (`LiveModelLoader.swift:295`). If `model` becomes the wrapper, the cast fails and `respondWithoutReasoning` silently keeps thinking on. `evict(container:)` (`:790-793`) also needs the raw model.
+   - Fork and replace-transcript (`LiveModelLoader.swift:522-545`) must use the wrapped model.
+4. A container with no executor seam (the test `StubSessionBackend` and its containers: about 60 test files; a third-party `LoadedLLMContainer`) gets no pass-level gating from the wrapper. Decide and write down what they get. Recommendation: stubs that script a tool loop take the queue for each scripted pass, so the queue behavior is testable without MLX.
+5. `RecordingLanguageModelState` (`Recording/RecordingLanguageModel.swift:120-123`, `:212-268`) takes `generationGate` around diff-and-record AND around `innerRespond`. When `container.languageModel` (`RoutedLLM.swift:325-327`) is the queued wrapper, the Recording path would wait on the same semaphore two times and deadlock. In the same change: give Recording its own lock for each handle for diff-and-record, and let the wrapper do the GPU queue. Do not ship this task in two parts.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] Two `LanguageModelSession`s over the same pool entry never run two executor passes at the same time (test with an executor-level scripted model that counts concurrent passes).
+- [ ] A pass that waits for a queue place and is cancelled throws `CancellationError` and does not leave a place taken (the permit count is 1 after).
+- [ ] `respondWithoutReasoning` still turns thinking off for a template-flag model (test that the raw model is found).
+- [ ] The Recording path records the same events as before; `RecordingLanguageModelTests` stay green except `:488`, which changes to the new lock.
+- [ ] Nothing in this task changes `beginTurn`/`endTurn` yet. The full suite is green. #generation-queue
\ No newline at end of file
